description: The five workflows .github/workflows/test-unit.yml, test-stress.yml, test-hygiene.yml, test-integration.yml and make.yml share the concurrency group ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}. GitHub Actions keeps at most one active and one pending run per group, so when three or more pull requests merge to main while a long run (unit or stress, 8 to 11 minutes) is active, a newer push to main displaces the older pending run and it ends cancelled without ever testing that main commit. In a four-merge burst, two of six main commits lost their unit and stress results this way.
goal: In each of the five workflows, change the top-level concurrency block so a pull_request run is grouped by workflow and head branch, and every other event is grouped by workflow, ref and commit SHA, so a main push is never evicted from a one-deep queue. Keep cancel-in-progress as the existing expression github.event_name == 'pull_request'. Match the block already used in .github/workflows/docker-build.yml. Change no job, step, trigger, permission or environment variable, and change no other file. The module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: do not edit them or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within the default 200-line budget.
rationale: docker-build.yml already uses a group keyed by head branch for pull requests and by ref plus SHA for pushes, with cancel-in-progress true only for pull requests. The five test workflows keep the plain workflow-and-ref group, which on main silently drops intermediate commits during burst merges. Aligning them keeps stale pull request runs cancelled while every main commit keeps its own check runs.
acceptance_criteria: Each of test-unit.yml, test-stress.yml, test-hygiene.yml, test-integration.yml and make.yml has a top-level concurrency group built from github.workflow, github.head_ref for pull_request events, and github.ref plus github.sha for all other events.
cancel-in-progress stays the expression github.event_name == 'pull_request' in all five files.
No job, step, trigger, permission or environment variable changes in any workflow; the diff in each file is limited to the concurrency group expression (and at most one comment line).
No other file changes, and holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and the budget-check script are untouched.
The existing workflow tests under apps/sandbox-executor/tests (test_workflow_triggers.py, test_ci_timing_gate.py, test_ci_bookkeeping_wiring.py) still pass under uv run pytest.
